title: Negation invariance of assignment weight
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $ho$ assign to each of the $n$ coordinates one of the states “free,” “fixed to $1$,” or “fixed to $-1$,” and let $ho^{-}$ be obtained by exchanging the two fixed states while leaving free states unchanged. For every real parameter $b4$, the product weight of $ho^{-}$, using coordinate weights $b4$ for a free state and $(1-b4)/2$ for either fixed state, equals the product weight of $ho$.
hypotheses_covered: A restriction state is assigned to each of the $n$ coordinates
